detail.longDescription: "The rings mark the site of the Amazon Free-Air CO2 Enrichment Experiment (AmazonFACE), which is set to launch in the next few months. The decade-long project will test how the forest might respond to atmospheres of the future, when rising carbon dioxide levels are likely to affect plant growth and carbon storage." https://www. nature.com/immersive/d41586-02 6-02909-3/index.html # Amazon # Forest # CO2 # Environment # Research # Biology
